title: Plasmon exciton coupling enhances second order nonlinear response in borophene ZnO hybrid structures
abstract: Nonlinear optical processes in low dimensional materials are often weak or symmetry forbidden, limiting their use in nanoscale light sources and on chip frequency conversion. Here, we show that combining two weakly nonlinear systems, anisotropic borophene and excitonic zinc oxide, yields an enhanced and resonant nonlinear response. In borophene ZnO heterostructures, cathodoluminescence reveals a two orders of magnitude enhancement at 400 nm and 800 nm, due to an enhanced two photon absorption process. Under tunable near infrared excitation, a clear second harmonic signal emerges with quadratic power dependence and strong resonance near 800 nm. We attribute this to nonlinear plasmon exciton coupling, which reshapes the excitonic response and enables efficient hybrid pathways for frequency conversion. These results establish anisotropic plasmon exciton hybridization as a route to controlling nonlinear optical responses in low dimensional heterostructures.

summaries.en: The paper reports that plasmon–exciton coupling in borophene–ZnO hybrid heterostructures strongly enhances and makes resonant the second-order nonlinear optical response, producing two-photon-absorption-related cathodoluminescence enhancements and clear, quadratically scaling second-harmonic signals under near-infrared excitation, especially near 800 nm.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，在硼烯（borophene）–氧化锌（ZnO）杂化异质结构中，等离子体–激子耦合会显著增强并使二阶非线性光学响应呈共振特征：在电致发光中于400 nm和800 nm附近出现与两光子吸收相关的两数量级增强；在可调近红外激发下，在800 nm附近还能观察到清晰的二次谐波信号且随功率呈二次方依赖，归因于耦合重塑激子响应并提供高效频率转换的混合通道。

title: Doubly topological harmonic generation
abstract: The proposition that band geometry alone can protect optical states against disorder has proven not merely theoretically elegant but experimentally incontrovertible. A key attribute of photonic topological systems is their capacity to simultaneously possess high-intensity excitations at multiple distinct frequencies that are confined to the same topological interface. However, exploiting this freedom to protect the interaction between at least two topological states has remained an open experimental challenge. Here, we report an interaction between two topological states, with one being precisely frequency-doubled to the other, supported in a hybrid plasmonic and photonic topological insulator via nonlinear phase matching. We find that the phase matching inherits a unique spin-momentum locking unseen in conventional nonlinear systems. This ability to bring two topological states into phase-matched nonlinear interaction at a single interface sets the stage for a new class of doubly protected nonlinear photonic devices, potentially finding implications in generating entangled photon pairs with enhanced resilience and robustness for secure quantum information technology.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates that a hybrid plasmonic-photonic topological insulator supports a nonlinear interaction where one topological state is precisely frequency-doubled to another via nonlinear phase matching that exhibits a distinctive spin-momentum locking, enabling doubly protected nonlinear photonic devices potentially useful for robust entangled-photon generation in secure quantum information technologies.
summaries.zh: 论文在混合等离子体-光子拓扑绝缘体中实现了非线性相互作用：通过非线性相位匹配使一个拓扑态精确频率加倍到另一个拓扑态，并发现其相位匹配具有传统非线性系统中未见的独特自旋-动量锁定，从而为双重受保护的新型非线性光子器件奠定基础，可能用于增强鲁棒性的纠缠光子对生成以服务于安全的量子信息技术。

title: Sensitive biodetection in flow using metasurface hosting quasi-bound state in the continuum resonances
abstract: We have designed optical metasurfaces hosting high-quality factor quasi-bound state in the continuum (q-BIC) resonances for optical biosensing in flow. The unit cell of the metasurface contains two rectangular bars. An asymmetry factor is introduced by varying the gap width between the bars, to enable optical coupling to a q-BIC resonance confined to the air gap between neighboring nanoresonators. The location of the resonances makes them highly sensitive to changes in the local refractive index, leading to experimental bulk refractive index sensitivities exceeding 315 +/- 22 nm/RIU and a figure-of-merit of 66 +/- 5 RIU-1. Successful streptavidin-biotin binding was observed by measuring the metasurface transmission in real-time by exposing the metasurface to various concentrations of analytes via a commercial microfluidic flow cell apparatus. The experimental limit of detection, defined as 3{\sigma} above noise, was found to be 1.8x10-8 M. This platform represents a compact optical approach for point-of-care diagnostics with fast read-out.

summaries.en: The paper presents a compact metasurface biosensing platform in which a gap-induced quasi-bound state in the continuum resonance yields high refractive-index sensitivity and enables real-time microfluidic detection of streptavidin–biotin with an experimental limit of detection of 1.
summaries.zh: 该论文提出了一种紧凑型纳米光学超表面生物传感平台，通过由缝隙不对称诱导的准束缚态在连续体（q-BIC）共振实现高折射率灵敏度，并在商业微流控流动池中实现链霉亲和素–生物素的实时检测，其实验检出限为1.

title: Intrinsic chirality of dielectric metasurfaces unlocked by resonant chiral modes
abstract: Controlling optical chirality at the subwavelength scales is essential for many applications of nanophotonic structures in polarization optics, sensing, and nonlinear photonics. Achieving a strong chiroptical response in planar dielectric metasurfaces without intrinsically chiral building blocks (or "meta-atoms") remains challenging. The recent theoretical study [ACS Photonics 12, 6717 (2025)] predicted that bilayer metasurfaces with rotated C$_4$-symmetric apertures can exhibit pronounced chiral response originating from resonant chiral photonic modes realizing maximum chirality under the mode strong coupling. That observation uncovers a novel mechanism of metasurface chirality. Here, we confirm experimentally this novel concept and demonstrate resonantly enhanced circular dichroism in the near-infrared frequency range. We fabricate a free-standing silicon membrane metasurface that is nominally achiral. When out-of-plane symmetry is broken by a thin PMMA layer, it unlocks and activates a strong chiral response. The observed circular dichroism is explained by the properties of chiral photonic modes, and it is governed by interlayer coupling and symmetry breaking, in agreement with theoretical predictions. These results establish bilayer metasurfaces as a simple and versatile platform for engineering strong mode-induced chirality in compact planar photonic metadevices.

summaries.en: The paper experimentally confirms that a nominally achiral free-standing silicon bilayer dielectric metasurface can show resonantly enhanced circular dichroism in the near-infrared by unlocking resonant chiral photonic modes through symmetry breaking from an added PMMA layer, with the effect governed by interlayer coupling and matching the prior theoretical predictions.
summaries.zh: 本文实验验证：一个名义上不具手性的悬空硅双层介质超表面可因通过外加PMMA层打破对称性而“解锁”谐振手性光子模，从而在近红外实现显著增强的圆二色性，其强度由层间耦合与对称破缺共同决定，并与既有理论预测一致。

title: General Criteria for Certifying Genuine High-Dimensional Quantum Teleportation
abstract: Developing reliable methods for certifying the dimension of a given quantum system or process is essential to ensure the validity of claimed realization of high-dimensional (HD) quantum advantages. The existing criteria for certifying genuine HD quantum teleportation (HDQT) mainly focus on demonstrating the successful transmission of genuine HD quantum states. However, a complete certification of HDQT must also identify the entanglement dimension of resource, which is critical for verifying whether the transmission capacity and noise resilience meet the necessary thresholds. Here we propose two universal criteria (based on fidelity and robustness, respectively) for certifying genuine HDQT behaviors that can close this gap by fully identifying the dimension of the entanglement. Both criteria require only the input and output teleportation data and remain feasible under partial Bell-state measurements. Furthermore, the robustness-based criterion has stronger noise resistance and it requires no prior assumptions about local operations, making it robust even in black-box scenario. Our results establish a universal and reliable theoretical framework for validating the core quantum advantage in HDQT, pivotal for ensuring the reliable links in HD quantum networks.

summaries.en: The paper introduces two universal certification criteria (fidelity-based and robustness-based) that, using only input–output teleportation data and remaining practical under partial Bell measurements or even black-box conditions, fully determine the entanglement dimension and thereby certify genuine high-dimensional quantum teleportation with strong noise resilience.
summaries.zh: 本文提出两种通用认证准则（基于保真度与基于鲁棒性），仅依赖输入—输出的传输数据，并且在部分贝尔态测量乃至黑盒场景下仍可行，从而完整确定纠缠维度并以更强的抗噪能力认证“真正”的高维量子传送。

title: Theory of Supercritical Coupling And Generalized Bound States in the Continuum
abstract: Bound states in the continuum (BICs) arise from destructive interference suppressing radiation despite spectral overlap with the continuum. Here we show that Friedrich--Wintgen interference naturally emerges from a bright--dark supermode decomposition of resonances coupled through a shared radiation channel. In this basis, any finite leakage of a quasi-BIC induces a causality-driven reactive coupling enabling non-Hermitian pumping of the dark sector. We derive the optimal condition for this process and show that it corresponds to the supercritical coupling regime previously identified in [Nature 626, 765 (2024)], while naturally recovering universal quasi-BIC asymmetry scaling. Extending the theory to Dirac-like dispersions in photonic crystal slabs, we identify an open-Dirac singularity where the Dirac gap matches the supercritical regime. A four-wave Hamiltonian quantitatively reproduces rigorous coupled-wave analysis, revealing the breakdown of conventional critical coupling. Near this regime, absorptive cross-coupling induces coherent absorption interference and enables suppression of effective dissipative losses beyond conventional material limits. These results motivate the concept of a generalized bound state in the continuum (gBIC) as a limiting non-Hermitian state where radiative and effective gain compensate, producing a true divergence of the total quality factor. Overall, this work establishes a unified framework connecting BIC interference, Dirac topology, and non-Hermitian physics for ultra-high-Q enhancement and loss engineering in open photonic systems.

summaries.en: The paper develops a unified theory linking bound states in the continuum to bright–dark supermode interference and non-Hermitian pumping, derives its supercritical-coupling condition, extends it to Dirac-like dispersion with an open-Dirac singularity, and shows via a four-wave model that generalized BICs enable quality-factor divergence and loss suppression beyond conventional critical-coupling limits.
summaries.zh: 本文提出了一种统一理论，将连续谱中的束缚态（BIC）与亮-暗超模分解下的干涉以及非厄米泵浦联系起来，推导出相应的超临界耦合条件，并扩展到狄拉克类色散中的开狄拉克奇点；通过四波哈密顿量定量复现实有耦合波分析结果，表明常规临界耦合在该区域失效，且吸收型交叉耦合可利用相干吸收干涉实现超越材料常规极限的有效耗散抑制，从而提出广义BIC（gBIC）概念并在辐射与有效增益补偿时实现总品质因数的发散。

title: Systematic Investigation and Suppression of Fluorescence in High-Sensitivity Cavity-Enhanced Raman Gas Sensing
abstract: Raman spectroscopy enables broadband, multi-species gas analysis by providing access to an entire vibrational spectrum in a single measurement. However, the sensitivity of gas-phase Raman sensing is often limited by weak signals and fluorescence background from various optical elements that constrain the achievable signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) through signal-dependent noise contributions (e.g. shot noise). Here, we present a cavity-enhanced Raman spectroscopy (CERS) gas sensor employing a 500 mW, 532 nm continuous wave (CW) laser and a simple, non-resonant two-mirror multi-pass cavity (MPC) operated at ambient pressure and near the concentric condition, providing up to 45 internal reflections. To quantitatively capture the impact of fluorescence on performance, a CCD-specific noise model was developed that links fluorescenceinduced baseline levels to measurement noise. Complementary optical simulations were employed to assess the signal collection efficiency in the MPC. Through a systematic analysis of fluorescence sources, the background was reduced substantially by step-wise elimination of fluorescent optics. The fluorescence-minimized setup resolves weak Raman signatures in ambient-air spectra, including CO2 peaks, O2 and N2 overtones, and ambient CH4 (2 ppm). Calibration measurements for O2 (diluted in N2), N2 (in O2) and H2 (in N2) demonstrate detection limits of 11 ppm, 5 ppm and 3 ppm, respectively, with a 180 s measurement time. The results highlight fluorescence mitigation as a key design lever for robust, field-oriented CERS instrumentation for trace gas sensing.

summaries.en: The paper presents a cavity-enhanced Raman gas sensor using a multi-pass cavity and a CCD noise model to quantify fluorescence-induced noise, then systematically removes fluorescent optics to suppress background and achieve ppm-level detection limits for several trace gases in ambient air.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种基于多通道腔增强拉曼的气体传感器，使用多程腔并建立CCD噪声模型以量化荧光引起的噪声影响，通过逐步更换/去除荧光光学元件系统性抑制背景，从而在环境空气中实现多种痕量气体的ppm级检测限。

title: Active control of phase matching in nonlinear metasurfaces using Pancharatnam--Berry phase
abstract: Reconfiguring the spectral output of nonlinear metasurfaces after fabrication remains challenging. We address this by exploiting the nonlinear Pancharatnam--Berry phase of $C_{3v}$-symmetric plasmonic metasurfaces. By integrating two metasurfaces inside a multipass cell, we experimentally demonstrate continuous spectral tuning of second-harmonic generation (SHG) phase-matching peaks across a 900--970 nm pump range by rotating one metasurface relative to the other. The extracted geometric phase follows the $3\sigma\theta$ dependence, and a full $2\pi$ tuning cycle is completed with $120^{\circ}$ of physical rotation. This establishes geometric-phase metasurfaces as a reconfigurable nonlinear platform, where mechanical rotation enables post-fabrication and broadband tuning of nonlinear optical responses.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates post-fabrication, mechanically reconfigurable control of second-harmonic generation phase matching in C3v-symmetric nonlinear metasurfaces by using Pancharatnam–Berry geometric phase, achieving continuous tuning of SHG phase-matching peaks from 900 to 970 nm via relative rotation with a 3σθ-derived phase and a full 2π cycle over 120° rotation.
summaries.zh: 论文利用具有C3v对称性的非线性超表面的Pancharatnam–Berry几何相位，通过将两块超表面置于多程池中并相对旋转，实现对二次谐波（SHG）相位匹配峰的后加工连续可调：在900–970 nm泵浦范围内用相对旋转获得相位匹配峰调谐，其几何相位满足3σθ依赖并在120°物理旋转内完成完整2π调谐循环，从而表明几何相位超表面是可重构非线性平台，可通过机械旋转实现宽带非线性光学响应调控。

title: Strong light enhancement by combining the photonic nanojet and plasmons from the nano-engineered microsphere
abstract: Today's cutting-edge optical spectroscopic exploratory tools, such as Raman or infrared spectroscopy, rely on methods of signal enhancement as a route for their development. These methods are indispensable for substance identification and characterization in almost any scientific, regulatory, or industrial laboratory, therefore new and better methods of enhancement are always sought after. In this paper, the design of a new optical device for enhancement is presented, called nano-engineered microsphere (NMS). This device innovatively combines plasmons, a present flagship enhancement method, with a photonic nanojet, a new and emerging enhancement tool, to provide unprecedented properties in terms of affordability, stability, and performance. By using numerical simulations, a detailed design of the device is presented, and the optimization of device parameters for the strongest enhancement is investigated. The simulations show different influences of the parameters on the enhancement, from low to critical. The most influential parameter was found to be the radius of the nanoelement tip, which, at low values, showed a tremendous increase in the enhancement. The optimized device shows exceptionally promising abilities regarding the enhancement, while the estimated cost of production and use is low. Such properties paired with low price and ease of usage could enable the NMS to become one of the leading methods of enhancement in Raman and infrared spectroscopy with the spatial resolution towards nanometers.

summaries.en: The paper presents a nano-engineered microsphere that combines photonic nanojets with plasmonic effects to achieve strong optical signal enhancement, using simulations to optimize key parameters—especially the nanoelement tip radius—and demonstrating promising, low-cost performance for Raman/infrared spectroscopy at near-nanometer spatial resolution.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种纳米工程微球装置，将光子纳米喷射与等离子体效应相结合以实现强光信号增强，并通过数值模拟优化关键参数（其中最重要的是纳米元尖端半径），结果显示其在拉曼/红外光谱中具有极具前景且低成本的增强性能，并望实现纳米级空间分辨率。

title: General and concise operator approach to the dyadic Green's function of layered media
abstract: Dyadic Green's function is an important tool of computational photonics, giving deeper insights into light-matter interaction. We present an operator approach to the derivation of the dyadic Green's function of a generic anisotropic planarly-layered medium for both electric and magnetic fields. The resulting Green's function is expressed through the evolution operators (a kind of transfer matrices) of the comprising layers and the surface impedance tensors, the singular term being naturally separated from other terms. The operator approach to the Green's function simplifies both the conceptual understanding of the problem and the subsequent practical applications, some of which are demonstrated here. The proposed approach can be easily generalized to the case of spherical and cylindrical layers. The obtained results can be applied in nanophotonics engineering problems.

summaries.en: The paper introduces a concise operator-based method to derive the dyadic Green’s function for general anisotropic planar layered media, expressing both electric and magnetic Green’s functions in terms of layer evolution (transfer-matrix) operators and surface impedance tensors while cleanly isolating the singular contribution and facilitating generalization to spherical/cylindrical layers and practical nanophotonics applications.
summaries.zh: 本文提出一种简洁的算符方法，用于推导一般各向异性平面分层介质的双偶格林函数，并将电场与磁场的格林函数分别用各层的演化（传输矩阵）算符和表面阻抗张量来表示，同时自然地将奇异项与其他项分离，进而便于概念理解与实际应用并可推广到球形/圆柱形分层结构，用于纳米光子工程问题。

title: Transmission of signals in the 300 GHz band with a bit-error rate below ${10}^{-9}$ using a soliton comb
abstract: To address the increasing demand for ultra-high-capacity wireless communication, terahertz (THz) frequencies near 300 GHz are attracting attention as a new spectral frontier. This work presents the first experimental demonstration of error-free (BER $< 1\times10^{-9}$) 10 Gbps transmission in the 300 GHz band using a soliton microcomb generated in an integrated silicon nitride (SiN) microring resonator. While many previous microcomb-based THz demonstrations have focused on coherent modulation formats and operation near the forward-error-correction (FEC) limit, this work investigates a simple intensity-modulation/direct-detection (IM-DD) on-off keying (OOK) architecture suitable for low-complexity THz links and fiber-wireless integrated systems. Although the experiment was conducted in a short back-to-back waveguide configuration, the generated THz wave enabled stable low-BER transmission without FEC or advanced offline signal processing. Analysis of the error-free threshold power indicates the feasibility of free-space transmission over several tens of meters with high-gain antennas and THz-band amplifiers. These results demonstrate the feasibility of robust low-complexity THz photonic links based on soliton microcombs for short-range fiber-wireless integrated systems.

summaries.en: The paper reports the first error-free (BER < 10^-9) 10 Gbps transmission at 300 GHz using a soliton microcomb from an integrated SiN microring resonator with a low-complexity IM-DD OOK scheme, achieving stable low-BER without FEC or advanced processing and indicating feasible short-range free-space links over tens of meters with sufficient antenna gain and THz amplification.
summaries.zh: 论文首次在300 GHz频段利用集成SiN微环谐振器产生的孤子微梳，采用低复杂度IM-DD OOK结构实现BER低于10^-9的10 Gbps无误传输，实验在无需FEC和无需高级离线处理的情况下获得稳定低误码，并通过误码阈值功率分析表明在高增益天线和THz段放大条件下可实现数十米量级的短距离自由空间链路可行性。

title: Controlled Steering-Based State Preparation for Adversarial-Robust Quantum Machine Learning
abstract: Quantum machine learning (QML) provides a promising framework for leveraging quantum-mechanical effects in learning tasks. However, its vulnerability to adversarial perturbations remains a major challenge for practical deployment. In QML systems, small perturbations applied to classical inputs can propagate through the quantum encoding stage and distort the resulting quantum state, thereby degrading model performance. In this work, we propose a defense mechanism that replaces the conventional quantum encoding stage of a QML model with passive steering-based controlled state preparation, which guides the encoded state toward a controlled intermediate state. By tuning the steering strength and the number of steering iterations, the proposed method suppresses the influence of adversarial perturbations while maintaining high clean accuracy and improving adversarial accuracy. Experimental results demonstrate that the passive steering-based defense consistently improves adversarial accuracy across different QML models and datasets under gradient-based adversarial attacks, achieving adversarial accuracy improvements of up to 40.19%.

summaries.en: The paper proposes a passive, steering-based controlled state preparation method that replaces standard quantum encoding in quantum machine learning to mitigate adversarial perturbations, suppressing their effect while preserving clean accuracy and improving adversarial accuracy by up to 40.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种被动的基于受控转向（steering）的受控态制备方法，用于替代量子机器学习中的传统量子编码，从而抑制对抗扰动对编码态的影响，既保持高干净精度又提升对抗精度，在梯度型对抗攻击下于不同模型和数据集上将对抗精度最高提高40.

title: Graph-State Circuit Blocks control Entanglement and Scrambling Velocities
abstract: Random circuit models often describe local dynamics using generic two-qubit gates, which have proven successful in capturing entanglement growth and operator spreading in many contexts. This approach naturally leads to the expectation that detailed gate structure plays only a limited role in coarse-grained entanglement and scrambling diagnostics. We show that the internal structure of multipartite circuit primitives can significantly influence these dynamical rates, even within a fixed random-circuit architecture. To investigate this, we study an exactly simulable family of Clifford quantum circuits built from fixed $n$-qubit graph-state preparation unitaries, which we treat as elementary building blocks. Specifically, we consider a one-dimensional chain of $N$ qubits initialized in a product state and evolved by layers in which nonoverlapping length-$n$ blocks are placed at uniformly random positions with sparsity $\alpha$. We find that different choices of graph-state building blocks lead to strongly varying dynamical rates. Graph states that are inequivalent under local Clifford (LC) transformations generate sharply different entanglement velocities $v_E$ and butterfly velocities $v_B$, even though the circuits are drawn from the same ensemble with identical architecture and randomness parameters. We further show that this hierarchy is captured by two complementary block-level characteristics: the distribution of entanglement across internal bipartitions of the graph state, which correlates with $v_E$, and a graph-theoretic connectivity profile across bipartitions, which correlates with $v_B$. Neither descriptor alone fully determines the dynamics; rather, entanglement growth and operator spreading are controlled by distinct structural features of the local circuit blocks. Notably, AME states appear among the fastest scrambling building blocks within the ensembles studied here.
subjects: Quantum Physics (quant-ph) ; High Energy Physics - Theory (hep-th)

summaries.en: The paper shows that, in exactly simulable random Clifford circuits built from length‑n graph‑state preparation blocks on a 1D qubit chain, the specific multipartite structure of the local graph‑state primitives—not just the coarse random-circuit architecture—strongly controls entanglement and operator-spreading rates, yielding distinct entanglement and butterfly velocities for graph states not related by local Clifford equivalence, with these rates explained by different block-level measures of internal bipartition entanglement distribution and graph connectivity profiles, and it finds that absolutely maximally entangled (AME) states can be among the fastest scrambling blocks.
summaries.zh: 论文证明，在一类可精确模拟的随机Clifford电路中（由长度为n的图态制备块构成、作用于一维量子比特链），即使随机电路的总体架构与随机性参数固定，不同多体局部图态原语的具体结构仍会显著决定动力学速率：对未被局域Clifford（LC）变换等价的图态，其熵纠缠增长速度与保蝴蝶速度会出现明显差异，并分别可由块层面的两种不同特征刻画——内部二分中的纠缠分布与跨二分的图论连通性谱；同时作者发现绝对最大纠缠态（AME）在所研究的体系中可能属于最快的纠缠/信息传播（快速湮灭）构件。

title: Tolerating Device Failure in Distributed Quantum Computing
abstract: It is desirable that a distributed quantum computer can operate despite the replacement or failure of its constituent components, allowing the reliability of the distributed system to exceed that of its subcomponents. We first show that when quantum error correction is performed over a modular quantum network, quantum devices can be swapped out or replaced, during operation, with minimal impact on logical error rates. We also investigate the ability of the toric and hyperbolic Floquet quantum error correcting codes to protect logical information under low rates of modular node failure. In particular, we show that under the proposed distributed quantum error scheme, the selected codes are able to maintain good logical error suppression during the failure of entire nodes. For catastrophic node failure of probability p/100, we suggest that a distributed toric code would outperform one implemented on a monolithic device below a physical error rate of 0.05%.

summaries.en: The paper shows that modular quantum error correction on a distributed quantum network can tolerate device replacement or node failures with little increase in logical error rates, using toric and hyperbolic Floquet codes, and finds that for catastrophic node failure probability p/100 a distributed toric code can outperform an equivalent monolithic implementation when physical error rates are below 0.
summaries.zh: 本文表明，在分布式量子网络上进行模块化量子纠错时，使用方顶（toric）与双曲（hyperbolic）Floquet 码可以在设备替换或节点失效时仅带来很小的逻辑误差率增幅；研究还表明，当灾难性节点失效概率为 p/100 时，所提出的分布式方顶码在物理错误率低于 0.

title: Analogue quantum simulation with polylogarithmic interaction strengths by extrapolating within phases of matter
abstract: Simple families of quantum Hamiltonians can simulate general many-body systems at arbitrary precision through the use of perturbative gadgets, however this generally requires interaction strengths spanning many orders of magnitude which scale polynomially in the system size and inverse precision, resulting in physically unrealisable systems. In this work, we show that for non-critical systems these required scalings can be exponentially reduced through classical post-processing, by simulating the model at smaller energy scales and extrapolating observables to the perturbative limit. In particular, we show that both local and extensive properties of thermal states with exponentially decaying correlations and ground states with a sufficiently stable gap can be simulated using gadgets whose interaction strengths scale only polylogarithmically in the inverse precision and the system size. As a key tool, we develop a generalised treatment of the local Schrieffer-Wolff transformation for geometrically quasi-local Hamiltonians over many energy scales, facilitating the analysis of perturbative gadget Hamiltonians without extensive global energy penalities, which may be of independent interest.

summaries.en: The paper shows that for non-critical many-body systems, analogue quantum simulations using perturbative gadgets can replace polynomially large interaction-strength requirements with polylogarithmic scaling in inverse precision and system size by simulating at reduced energy scales and extrapolating observables to the perturbative limit, supported by a generalized multi-scale local Schrieffer–Wolff framework for quasi-local Hamiltonians.
summaries.zh: 该论文表明，对于非临界多体系统，通过在较低能标下进行扰动极限的可模拟性并对观测量进行外推，同时发展适用于几何准局域哈密顿量的多能标局域施里弗–沃尔夫广义处理，基于扰动“彗星”量子模拟的所需相互作用强度可将原本随逆精度和系统尺寸多项式增长的困难从而降低为仅随逆精度和系统尺寸呈对数幂级（polylogarithmic）增长，从而实现对具有指数衰减关联的热态以及具有足够稳定能隙的基态的有效模拟。

title: String Diagrams for Quantum Foundations, Computing and Natural Language Processing
abstract: Applied category theory provides powerful mathematical tools for modelling processes and their composition. Symmetric monoidal categories, which involve series and parallel composition, are particularly well-suited for describing the composition of processes in space and time. Also called process theories, they admit string diagrams, which constitute a visually intuitive, mathematically rigorous, expressive and flexible syntax that is applicable to wide-ranging scientific domains. In this thesis, we employ string diagrams to investigate a selection of topics in the areas of quantum foundations, computing, and natural language processing: (1) We formalise constructor theory as a process theory. In the context of quantum physics, we also demonstrate the conflict between constructor-theoretic principles of locality and composition. Moreover, we argue that if the principle of locality is rejected, categorical quantum mechanics (CQM) can be conceived as a constructor theory of quantum physics. (2) We develop a formalism for wave-based logic circuits with phase encoding. We motivate the formalism using the example of spin-wave circuits, and then demonstrate its utility in design, analysis and optimisation of Boolean logic circuits. (3) We investigate the elimination of inter-language grammatical bureaucracy in the distributional compositional circuits (DisCoCirc) framework. In particular, we develop a hybrid grammar for a restricted fragment of the Urdu language, and show that Urdu text endowed with this hybrid grammar maps surjectively to DisCoCirc text circuits. Furthermore, we show that for the same language fragment, Urdu and English text circuits become the same up to gate-level translation. The aforementioned work supports the view that a process-relational outlook in science is well-supported by applied category-theoretic tools, particularly string diagrams.

summaries.en: The thesis uses symmetric monoidal process theories and string diagrams to model and study problems in quantum foundations, wave-based quantum-inspired logic circuits, and distributional compositional NLP, including formalizing constructor theory, addressing locality-composition conflicts for quantum physics, developing phase-encoded wave logic circuit formalisms, and showing how hybrid grammatical rules for Urdu yield circuit models that relate Urdu and English via gate-level translations.
summaries.zh: 本论文利用对称单幺过程理论与弦图工具，在量子基础、带相位编码的波形逻辑电路以及分布式组合式自然语言处理等方向开展研究：包括将构造子理论形式化为过程理论、讨论量子物理中“局域性-组合”原则的冲突并在拒绝局域性时将CQM视为构造子理论、构建相位编码波逻辑电路的形式化方法用于布尔逻辑电路的设计分析与优化，以及在DisCoCirc框架下为乌尔都语片段建立混合语法从而证明其文本电路对DisCoCirc文本到达且乌尔都语与英语在门级翻译下等价。

title: Loss-induced quantum nonreciprocity and entanglement in superconducting qubits
abstract: Losses are ubiquitous in physics and are usually regarded as harmful in quantum information processing. Here, we propose a loss-induced scheme to achieve nonreciprocity and nonreciprocal entanglement in a superconducting platform, where two remote superconducting transmon qubits are connected via two lossy auxiliary cavities. The nonreciprocity in our scheme originates from interference between multiple lossy coupling paths. The coherent phases associated with the qubit-resonator couplings reverse sign under propagation reversal, while the loss-induced phases remain direction independent. Their combined effect leads to different interference conditions in the opposite directions, resulting in unequal effective couplings. We show that this loss-induced scheme can generate nonreciprocal quantum entanglement, indicating that loss can be utilized as a resource. Moreover, the tunability of nonreciprocity and nonreciprocal entanglement in our scheme can be manipulated by the relative phase induced by loss, allowing to tailor both reciprocal and nonreciprocal behaviors. Our results establish a direct link between engineered loss and nonreciprocal entanglement in quantum information processing and offer potential applications in scalable quantum networks.

summaries.en: The paper presents a loss-engineered superconducting-circuit method using two lossy auxiliary cavities to connect remote transmon qubits, where interference among lossy coupling paths creates direction-dependent effective couplings that enable nonreciprocal quantum entanglement and tunable nonreciprocal behavior, showing that loss can be a resource for scalable quantum networks.
summaries.zh: 论文提出一种基于损耗工程的超导方案：通过两个有损的辅助腔体连接远距离的两颗超导瞬态（transmon）量子比特，利用多个有损耦合路径之间的干涉产生方向相关的有效耦合，从而实现非互易量子纠缠并可调控非互易行为，表明损耗可以作为量子信息处理中的一种资源并用于可扩展的量子网络。

title: Digital Annealer-Assisted Accuracy-First Quantum Circuit Transpilation with Integrated QUBO Mapping and Routing
abstract: In the Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) era, limited qubit counts and high gate error rates directly constrain circuit fidelity, making the minimization of CNOT gate counts crucial. While conventional compilers prioritize heuristic efficiency, there is a compelling need for "accuracy-first" transpilation that prioritizes gate reduction over compilation latency. We propose a framework leveraging the Digital Annealer (DA) via two complementary strategies: (1) Hybrid, which uses DA-driven global initial mapping combined with high-speed heuristic routing by Qiskit, and (2) Full DA, which solves mapping and routing as separate DA-assisted QUBO subproblems within an iterative workflow. Benchmarks demonstrate that our Hybrid approach achieves an average CNOT reduction of 13.7 % (up to 57.4 %) compared to Qiskit's highest optimization level, with the largest gains on structured circuits such as GHZ and ASP where the initial layout is decisive. The Full DA approach matches Hybrid on structured circuits and outperforms ISAAQ by 23.1 % on average (maximum 90.8 %), but degrades on circuits with random or concentrated connectivity - exposing a trade-off between QUBO size and solution quality when the entire circuit is encoded in a single annealing pass. Although these global optimizations incur higher computational overhead than pure heuristics, our results indicate that for high-precision workflows where gate noise is the primary bottleneck, DA-assisted global initial placement provides a practical "time-for-quality" trade-off for enhancing the utility of near-term quantum hardware.

summaries.en: The paper presents two digital-annealer-based “accuracy-first” quantum circuit transpilation strategies that formulate qubit mapping and routing as QUBO problems (globally via DA with either hybrid heuristic routing or fully separate DA-assisted subproblems), showing that the hybrid approach reduces CNOT counts by 13.
summaries.zh: 论文提出两种基于数字退火器（DA）的“精度优先”量子电路转译方法：将量子比特布局与路由映射为QUBO问题（要么DA全局求初始映射再用启发式路由的混合方案，要么把映射与路由分别作为DA辅助子问题进行迭代），结果表明混合方案相较最强Qiskit优化平均可减少13.

title: QuBridge: Layer-wise Fidelity Decomposition in Quantum Computation Pipeline
abstract: Running a quantum circuit on current hardware involves a sequence of engineering decisions, each with tunable parameters and distinct error characteristics. Existing tools optimize each decision in isolation, leaving practitioners unable to determine how much each decision contributes to final output quality. We present QuBridge, a pipeline analysis tool that decomposes quantum computation into three decision layers and measures each layer's fidelity contribution through progressive ablation and isolation experiments. Applied to quantum teleportation under IBM-calibrated noise models, the framework surfaces three phenomena that end-to-end measurement obscures. Qubit selection narrows the worst-case fidelity band from 11.8% to under 2% with downstream layers held fixed, without changing the peak. Per-gate pulse-shape assignment adds a +0.9% residual gain whose attributed magnitude depends on upstream layout. Error-detection encoding is not uniformly advantageous, and its conditional benefit emerges for input states whose dominant error channel is detectable by the chosen code. QuBridge operates on cached calibration data without requiring live hardware access.

summaries.en: QuBridge is a pipeline analysis method that decomposes a quantum computation into three decision layers and quantifies each layer’s fidelity contribution via ablation/isolation experiments, revealing case-specific effects in quantum teleportation under IBM-calibrated noise while running offline on cached calibration data.
summaries.zh: QuBridge 提出一种管线分析方法，将量子计算分解为三层决策并通过消融/隔离实验量化各层对保真度的贡献，在离线使用缓存标定数据的条件下，于IBM标定噪声下的量子传送任务中揭示了端到端测量所掩盖的特定现象。

title: Telecom quantum memory over one microsecond in nanophotonic lithium niobate
abstract: Nanophotonic quantum memory is a vital component for scalable quantum information processing in quantum computing, networking, and sensing. Here we store single-photon-level telecom-band optical pulses for more than 1 microsecond using an atomic frequency comb in erbium-doped thin-film lithium niobate, far exceeding what is practically achievable by propagation in even the best nanophotonic devices because of propagation losses. We verify the quantum nature of this storage by demonstrating phase coherence and sub-single-photon noise upon retrieval. We also show the flexibility of our platform by storing up to 20 temporal modes and demonstrating an acceptance bandwidth up to 2.2 GHz. These results establish erbium-doped thin-film lithium niobate as a practical platform for on-chip quantum memory at telecom wavelengths, a key missing element for photonic quantum computing and quantum networking.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates on-chip telecom-band quantum memory by storing single-photon-level pulses for over one microsecond in erbium-doped thin-film lithium niobate using an atomic frequency comb, verifying quantum storage via phase coherence and sub-single-photon noise, and showing multi-mode (up to 20) and GHz acceptance bandwidth performance suitable for scalable photonic quantum computing and networking.
summaries.zh: 该论文在铒掺杂薄膜铌酸锂中利用原子频率梳实现了在太通信号波段对单光子量级脉冲进行超过1微秒的片上量子存储，并通过相干性与亚单光子噪声验证存储的量子特性，同时展示最多20个时间模以及高达2.

title: Chaos Emerge with Exceptional Points in Reset-Driven Floquet Dynamics
abstract: We investigate the spectral structure of reset-driven Floquet quantum channels generated by the Hamiltonian evolution of a many-body system followed by periodic resetting of a bath. By tuning a chaos-controlling parameter in the underlying Hamiltonian, we uncover an exceptional-point-induced spectral transition from a symmetry-constrained ergodic regime to a fully chaotic regime. Across this transition, increasing the chaos parameter causes the real eigenvalues of the channel to drift, coalesce at exceptional points, and bifurcate into complex-conjugate pairs, signaling the progressive breaking of symmetry constraints in operator space. We further show that the channel spectrum sharply distinguishes chaotic, ergodic, many-body localized, and scarred dynamical regimes. Finally, we connect the leading channel eigenvalues to experimentally accessible probes based on quantum mutual information, establishing a link between the spectral organization of reset-driven quantum channels and observable relaxation dynamics.

summaries.en: The paper analyzes reset-driven Floquet quantum channels and shows that tuning a Hamiltonian chaos parameter drives an exceptional-point spectral transition from a symmetry-constrained ergodic regime to a fully chaotic regime, with eigenvalue coalescence and complex-pair bifurcation reflecting symmetry breaking, while using the channel spectrum to distinguish chaotic, ergodic, many-body localized, and scarred dynamics and relate leading eigenvalues to experimentally measurable mutual-information-based relaxation probes.
summaries.zh: 论文研究了由多体哈密顿演化与周期性浴重置共同生成的重置驱动弗洛凯量子通道谱结构，发现通过调节哈密顿量中的混沌控制参数，可由异常点诱导发生从受对称性约束的遍历态到完全混沌态的谱转变；在该转变过程中，信道的实特征值随混沌参数漂移并在异常点处合并，再分裂成共轭复特征值对，表征算符空间中对称性约束的逐步破缺，并进一步用信道谱区分混沌、遍历、多体局域化和刷子（scar）动力学，同时将领先特征值与基于量子互信息的可实验探测联系起来，从而把重置驱动量子通道的谱组织与可观测的弛豫动力学对应起来。

title: Realization of Backward Retrieval in a Stark-modulated Spin-wave Quantum Memory
abstract: We report the first experimental realization of backward retrieval in a spin-wave quantum memory based on a Stark-echo-modulated protocol in Eu3+:Y2SiO5. By using Stark control, we preserve the full optical depth of the ensemble while suppressing coherent noise, enabling conditional storage fidelities above 97%. Our analysis shows that the present backward-retrieval efficiency is mainly limited by technical imperfections rather than by fundamental constraints. With realistic engineering improvements, backward retrieval in this protocol could move beyond the reabsorption-limited forward-emission regime. The protocol is also compatible with cavity-enhanced operation, offering an additional route toward higher efficiencies. These findings establish Stark-echo modulation as a practical and scalable route to high-efficiency, long-lived solid-state quantum memories.

summaries.en: The paper reports the first experimental backward retrieval in a Stark-echo-modulated spin-wave quantum memory using Eu3+:Y2SiO5, achieving conditional storage fidelities above 97% by preserving full optical depth while suppressing coherent noise, with efficiency currently limited by technical imperfections and projected to surpass forward-emission limits via engineering and possible cavity enhancement.
summaries.zh: 论文首次在Eu3+:Y2SiO5中实现了基于Stark-echo调制的自旋波量子存储器的后向检索，并通过Stark控制在保持完整光学深度的同时抑制相干噪声，使条件存储保真度超过97%；分析表明当前效率主要受技术缺陷限制而非基础约束，借助工程改进并结合腔增强等方案有望超越前向发射受再吸收限制的上限，从而确立Stark-echo调制作为高效率、长寿命固态量子存储的可扩展实现路径。

title: Pre-Asymptotic Trainability in Photonic Variational Circuits under Postselection
abstract: Barren plateaus in variational quantum circuits are commonly attributed to strong mixing dynamics that cause gradient variance to vanish exponentially with system size. Passive photonic circuits, central to linear optical quantum computing, challenge this picture: although their Hilbert space can be exponentially large, their dynamics are constrained to a Lie algebra whose dimension scales as the square of the number of modes. In photonic systems, postselection also plays a central role, with gradient concentration governed not by the Hilbert-space dimension but by how it reshapes the effective observable. Through exact statevector simulations, we compare allow-bunching evolution, collision-free filtering, and dual-rail postselection. In the allow-bunching and collision-free regimes, gradient variance remains consistent with polynomial rather than exponential decay over the tested system sizes. By contrast, dual-rail postselection induces exponential concentration beyond moderate system sizes, robustly across three initialization ensembles. These results indicate that photonic barren plateaus are governed by the interplay between passive linear-optical dynamics, postselection geometry, and task observables, offering practical guidance for designing near-term photonic variational architectures.

summaries.en: The paper shows via exact statevector simulations that in passive photonic variational circuits postselection can either preserve polynomial gradient-variance decay (for allow-bunching or collision-free filtering) or cause exponential gradient concentration (for dual-rail postselection), implying photonic barren plateaus are determined by the interaction of linear-optical Lie-algebra constraints, postselection geometry, and the task observable.
summaries.zh: 论文通过精确的态矢仿真表明：在被动光子变分电路中，后选择既可能在允许成团或无碰撞过滤条件下保持梯度方差的多项式衰减，也可能在双轨后选择下在中等规模后引发梯度的指数级集中，进而说明光子型“贫瘠平台”由线性光学的李代数约束、后选择几何与任务可观测量之间的相互作用共同决定，并为近程光子变分架构设计提供指导。

title: Joint Realizability Tradeoffs Bounded by Quantum Channel Incompatibility
abstract: Incompatible quantum channels cannot be jointly and exactly realized, meaning that any approximate joint realization inevitably entails a tradeoff in implementation accuracy. While this notion of channel incompatibility unifies fundamental limitations such as measurement uncertainty, the no information without disturbance principle, and the no-cloning and no-broadcasting theorems, connecting these traditional relations directly to the resource-theoretic strength of incompatibility has remained elusive. In this Letter, we show that generalized robustness, a typical resource quantifier of channel incompatibility, lower bounds the total error of any approximate joint realization. Applying this result to measurement channels provides a unified, model-independent framework encompassing error-error and information-error-disturbance tradeoffs. Furthermore, our robustness-based evaluation of disturbance outperforms an algebraic bound for all POVMs in dimensions up to six.

summaries.en: The paper proves that the generalized robustness of quantum channel incompatibility lower-bounds the total implementation error for any approximate joint realization, yielding a unified, model-independent framework for error–tradeoffs among measurement channels that matches and can outperform prior algebraic bounds (tested up to dimension six).
summaries.zh: 论文证明，量子信道不相容的广义鲁棒度能够下界任意近似联合实现的总实现误差，从而对测量信道给出统一且与模型无关的误差权衡框架，并在维度不超过六的情形下显示其评估失真的方法优于以往的代数界。

title: Enabling Deterministic Passive Quantum State Transfer with Giant Atoms
abstract: Achieving quantum state transfer in passive ways can become a powerful asset for scalable quantum networks. Here, we demonstrate how giant atoms coupled to 1D waveguides provide a platform for such a passive, deterministic transfer. Engineering the position and strength of coupling points, we show that the nonlocal interaction can be utilized for the emission of time-reversal-symmetric single-photon wavepackets by spontaneous decay. We first derive general analytical conditions under which arbitrary qubit decays can be mapped to wavevector-dependent couplings that guarantee perfect state transfer in the continuum limit of infinitely many coupling points. Then, for experimentally relevant configurations with a finite number of coupling points, we demonstrate that high transfer fidelities can still be achieved by optimization, reaching 87% with only two coupling points and exceeding 99% with ten or more. We further analyze the robustness of the protocol against disorder in leg positioning and extend the formalism to environments with nonlinear dispersion, showing that dispersion-induced distortions can be fully compensated by judiciously chosen setups. Our results establish giant atoms as a powerful platform for realizing high-fidelity quantum state transfer in a setting without time-dependent control, opening new avenues for scalable quantum networks and engineered light-matter interfaces.

summaries.en: The paper shows that giant atoms coupled to 1D waveguides can enable passive, deterministic and high-fidelity quantum state transfer by engineering coupling points so spontaneous emission produces time-reversal-symmetric single-photon wavepackets, deriving conditions for perfect transfer in the infinite-coupling limit and demonstrating >87% fidelity with two points and >99% with ten or more while also proving robustness to positioning disorder and compensation of nonlinear-dispersion distortions.
summaries.zh: 论文表明，将“巨型原子”耦合到1维波导并通过设计耦合点，可以实现无需时间依赖控制的被动、确定性且高保真量子态传输；作者推导了在耦合点趋于无穷时实现完美传输的解析条件，并在实验相关的有限耦合点配置中证明：两处耦合点可达87%以上、十处或更多可超过99%，同时分析了对支架位置无序的鲁棒性，并给出了在非线性色散环境下通过合适设置补偿色散引起失真的方法。

title: Benchmarking and Resource Analysis for Augmented-Lagrangian Quantum Hamiltonian Descent
abstract: Quantum Hamiltonian Descent (QHD) is a continuous optimization algorithm based on simulating a time-dependent quantum Hamiltonian whose potential energy encodes the objective function and whose kinetic energy promotes exploration through quantum interference and tunneling. While QHD is formulated for unconstrained optimization, many real-world optimization problems are constrained and highly nonconvex. In this paper, we benchmark AL-QHD, a hybrid framework that embeds QHD within the Augmented Lagrangian Method (ALM), thereby solving a sequence of unconstrained subproblems while using ALM to enforce constraints. We evaluate AL-QHD on standard nonconvex test functions and use iterative refinement to improve solution accuracy at fixed per-run qubit cost. We also perform a gate-based resource analysis on ACOPF-derived power system subproblems constructed from power-network data to estimate the quantum-computer scale required for practical applications. Resource estimates on Texas7k-derived ACOPF instances show steep hard-gate scaling, reaching $\sim 4.46 \times 10^7$ entangling gates in a NISQ-oriented model and $\sim 9.42 \times 10^8$ T gates in a fault-tolerant model at $\sim 5.3 \times 10^2$ active variables. These results suggest that AL-QHD is a useful framework for studying constrained nonconvex optimization with QHD, but that practical ACOPF-scale applications would likely require large-scale fault-tolerant quantum hardware.

summaries.en: The paper benchmarks AL-QHD, a constrained nonconvex optimization framework that embeds Quantum Hamiltonian Descent within the Augmented Lagrangian Method and refines accuracy under fixed qubit cost, and it performs gate-level resource analyses on power-system ACOPF instances showing steep hard-gate and very large fault-tolerant requirements (up to ~9.
summaries.zh: 本文对将量子哈密顿下降嵌入增广拉格朗日法以处理约束非凸优化的AL-QHD进行基准测试，并在固定每次运行比特成本下通过迭代精炼提升精度，同时对由电力系统ACOPF构造的子问题做门级资源分析，结果表明硬门数增长陡峭且容错模型所需T门数巨大（最高约9.

title: Squeezing and adiabaticity breaking in time-dependent quantum harmonic oscillators
abstract: The quantum harmonic oscillator with time-dependent frequency is a paradigmatic model of driven quantum dynamics and one of the few nontrivial systems that admits an exact analytical solution. In this review paper, we present a unified treatment of the time-dependent oscillator based on the Lewis-Riesenfeld invariant method, Bogoliubov transformations and the Ermakov-Pinney equation. We show how these approaches naturally connect to squeezing for the description of excitations production, and to the breakdown of adiabaticity under generic frequency protocols. Exact results for sudden quenches and smooth ramps are discussed in detail. By explicitly bridging invariant methods and squeezing formalism, this review is meant to provide a comprehensive framework for understanding nonequilibrium dynamics in quadratic potentials, with applications ranging from thermodynamics and condensed matter to quantum control theory.

summaries.en: This review unifies exact solution techniques for a quantum harmonic oscillator with time-dependent frequency—via Lewis-Riesenfeld invariants, Bogoliubov transformations, and the Ermakov-Pinney equation—to explain squeezing-driven excitation production and generic adiabaticity breakdown, including detailed results for sudden quenches and smooth ramps.
summaries.zh: 这篇综述通过刘易斯-里森菲尔德不变量、玻色-奥博洛夫变换以及埃尔马科夫-平尼方程，统一处理了时变频率量子谐振子这一可解析模型，并说明由挤压表述的激发产生以及一般频率协议下绝热性失效的机制，同时对突变猝冷与平滑跃迁给出了详细精确结果。

title: Leggett--Garg Tests in Neural Dynamics: Probing Non-Diffusive Stochastic Structure in Single Neurons
abstract: We propose an experimental programme to test Leggett--Garg-type temporal correlations in single-neuron dynamics. The goal is to distinguish between diffusive (Wiener/cable-equation) models and non-diffusive persistent stochastic models based on Kac-type finite-velocity processes leading to the Telegrapher's equation. We show that while purely diffusive dynamics satisfies Leggett--Garg inequalities, persistent stochastic dynamics can produce oscillatory temporal correlations capable of violating these inequalities. The Leggett--Garg inequality may be viewed as a temporal analogue of Bell-type constraints. In the present context, however, violation is interpreted conservatively not as evidence of microscopic quantum coherence, but as evidence against a simple trajectory-based diffusive description. The resulting temporal correlations indicate persistence, memory, and contextual temporal structure mathematically analogous to that encountered in quantum systems. Using the analytic continuation connecting Kac processes to Dirac-like envelope equations, we argue that finite-velocity persistent stochastic transport provides a natural mechanism for such non-diffusive temporal correlations. These tests therefore offer a possible experimental probe of contextual and non-Markovian structure in neural dynamics without requiring claims of microscopic quantum coherence in the brain.

summaries.en: The paper proposes using Leggett–Garg temporal-correlation tests on single-neuron dynamics to differentiate diffusive (Wiener/cable-equation) models from non-diffusive persistent finite-velocity stochastic processes (Kac/telegrapher dynamics), showing that the latter can yield oscillatory correlations that violate Leggett–Garg inequalities and thus argue against simple diffusive trajectory descriptions without claiming microscopic quantum coherence.
summaries.zh: 论文提出在单神经元动力学中使用Leggett–Garg时间相关性检验，以区分符合扩散模型（Wiener/电缆方程）的机制与非扩散的持续有限速度随机过程（Kac/双曲型传输方程），并表明后者可产生振荡时间相关从而违反Leggett–Garg不等式，因而反对简单的扩散轨迹描述，但不声称大脑存在微观量子相干。

title: Understanding oxide-thickness-dependent variability in dense Si-MOS quantum dot arrays
abstract: Achieving uniform and scalable control of semiconductor spin qubits remains a key challenge for large scale quantum computing. In this work, we investigate how gate oxide thickness influences uniformity in dense two dimensional silicon quantum dot arrays. Using a 7 x 7 array fabricated in a 300 mm CMOS-process patterned by EUV lithography, we statistically characterize 392 quantum dots across four different oxide thicknesses. The threshold voltages, capacitances, lever arms, and charging energies are extracted using parallel row based measurements and we identify an optimal SiO2 thickness of 17 nm that minimizes threshold voltage variability below 63 mV standard deviation. Our observations illustrate how multiple sources of disorder can introduce competing oxide-thickness dependencies, resulting in non-monotonic trends. These results provide key design guidelines for dense, scalable silicon spin qubit architectures.

summaries.en: The paper statistically studies how SiO2 gate-oxide thickness affects electrical uniformity in a dense 7×7 CMOS-fabricated Si-MOS quantum dot array, finding a non-monotonic relationship with several disorder sources and identifying an optimal 17 nm oxide thickness that minimizes threshold-voltage variability (below 63 mV standard deviation), yielding design guidance for scalable silicon spin qubit architectures.
summaries.zh: 论文通过对300 mm CMOS工艺、EUV光刻制备的7×7致密Si-MOS量子点阵列进行统计测量，研究发现SiO2栅氧厚度会以非单调方式影响阈值电压等表征参数的均一性，且由多种无序来源导致相互竞争的氧厚依赖性；其中17 nm氧厚可将阈值电压变异性降到63 mV标准差以下，为可扩展硅自旋量子比特架构提供了设计指导。

title: Cryogenic Systems for Quantum Photonic Technologies: A Practical Review
abstract: While nonclassical light sources are fundamental to quantum communication and computing, solid-state platforms like color centers and quantum dots require cryogenic temperatures to reach the performance levels necessary for practical applications. Over the past decade, low-temperature engineering has transitioned from manual handling of liquid cryogens to automated closed-cycle cryostats. This review details the principles behind modern cooling hardware ranging from flow cryostats to mechanical cryocoolers and dilution refrigerators, with a specific focus on the requirements of optical quantum devices. Aimed at the practicing scientist, this overview provides the technical insights and historical context needed to navigate the current cryogenic landscape and evaluate its role in the future of quantum technology deployment.

summaries.en: The paper reviews how quantum photonic solid-state sources require cryogenic operation and traces the shift from manually managed liquid cryogens to automated closed-cycle cryostats, explaining the principles and optical-device requirements of modern cooling systems including flow cryostats, mechanical cryocoolers, and dilution refrigerators for practical quantum deployment.
summaries.zh: 该论文综述了量子光子固态器件（如色心和量子点）为达到可用性能所需的低温条件，并回顾过去十年从人工操作液氦/液氮等液体制冷向自动化闭环低温系统的发展，重点阐述流动式低温恒温器、机械制冷机和稀释制冷机等制冷硬件的原理及对光学量子器件的具体要求，旨在为从业科研人员提供理解与评估未来量子技术落地所需的技术洞见与历史背景。

title: Information Thermodynamics in Generalized Probabilistic Theories
abstract: Generalized Probabilistic Theories (GPTs) provide a unified framework for describing probabilistic physical theories, encompassing classical and quantum theories as well as hypothetical theories beyond quantum mechanics. Since most GPTs are highly unrealistic and far removed from known physical theories, it is important to constrain them by physically reasonable principles. One of the most important such principles is consistency with thermodynamics, which has been extensively studied through toy models involving semipermeable membranes (SPMs) implementing measurements. On the other hand, information thermodynamics, which plays a central role in understanding the relationship between measurement and thermodynamics in classical and quantum theory, has remained largely undeveloped in GPTs. In this work, we construct information thermodynamics in GPTs and provide a unified framework for analyzing the relationship between measurement, feedback, information erasure, and the second law of thermodynamics. We also formulate a general framework for SPM models and analyze the thermodynamic cost of measurements implemented by SPMs. As a result, we show that no work can be extracted in contradiction with the second law as long as the measurement processes are consistent with entropy nondecrease, and derive sufficient conditions for this property for several entropy definitions proposed in GPTs. Moreover, by considering measurement processes violating these conditions, we construct explicit GPT systems realizing isothermal SPM cycles from which positive work can be extracted. These results demonstrate that violations of the second law can arise from the lack of fundamental entropy properties or discrepancies between entropy definitions, and provide a unified and model-independent foundation for understanding the relationship between thermodynamics and measurement in GPTs.

summaries.en: The paper develops a unified information-thermodynamics framework for generalized probabilistic theories (GPTs), deriving conditions under which semipermeable-membrane (SPM) measurement processes cannot yield work beyond the second law and identifying how violations can arise from missing entropy properties or mismatches between GPT entropy definitions through explicit counterexamples.
summaries.zh: 本文在广义概率理论（GPTs）中构建了统一的信息热力学框架，推导在半透膜（SPM）测量过程满足特定熵非减一致性条件时不得违反第二定律从而无法提取有功，并通过具体反例表明在某些情况下由于基础熵性质缺失或不同GPT熵定义之间不一致也可能导致第二定律被破坏。

title: QAP-Router: Tackling Qubit Routing as Dynamic Quadratic Assignment with Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Qubit routing is a fundamental problem in quantum compilation, known to be NP-hard. Its dynamic nature makes local routing decisions propagate and compound over time, making global efficient solutions challenging. Existing heuristic methods rely on local rules with limited lookahead, while recent learning-based approaches often treat routing as a generic sequential decision problem without fully exploiting its underlying structure. In this paper, we introduce QAP-Router, framing qubit routing based on a dynamic Quadratic Assignment Problem (QAP) formulation. By modeling logical interactions, or quantum gates, as flow matrices and hardware topology as a distance matrix, our approach captures the interaction-distance coupling in a unified objective, which defines the reward in the reinforcement learning environment. To further exploit this structure, the policy network employs a solution-aware Transformer backbone that encodes the interaction between the flow matrix and the distance matrix into the attention mechanism. We also integrate a lookahead mechanism that blends naturally into the QAP framework, preventing myopic decisions. Extensive experiments on 1,831 real-world quantum circuits from the MQTBench, AgentQ and QUEKO datasets show that our method substantially reduces the CNOT gate count of routed circuits by 15.7%, 30.4% and 12.1%, respectively, relative to existing industry compilers.

summaries.en: The paper proposes QAP-Router, a reinforcement-learning qubit-routing method that formulates dynamic qubit routing as a structure-exploiting dynamic quadratic assignment problem with a solution-aware Transformer and QAP-compatible lookahead, achieving sizable CNOT reductions on 1,831 benchmark quantum circuits versus industry compilers.
summaries.zh: 本文提出QAP-Router方法，将动态比特路由建模为可利用结构的动态二次指派问题，并结合解法感知Transformer与与QAP相融合的前瞻机制进行强化学习，基于1831个基准量子电路实验结果相对业界编译器显著降低CNOT门数量（15.

title: Sub-shot-noise emission statistics of a CW-excited single photon source
abstract: Shot noise sets a fundamental limit on the sensitivity of classical optical measurements, with coherent emitters achieving the lowest possible shot-noise level. Emission from sub-Poissonian light provides a pathway to surpass this limit, and single-photon sources provide a natural platform for generating such light. However, it is commonly assumed that continuously excited single-photon sources exhibit Poissonian statistics. In this work, a theoretical model of a continuously driven two-level single-photon source is developed, treating both excitation and radiative decay as stochastic processes. The analysis demonstrates that photon emission can display sub-Poissonian statistics when excitation and decay rates are comparable, showing that continuous excitation does not inherently preclude nonclassical emission. The model is further extended to include finite detection efficiency and detector dead time, illustrating how these practical non-idealities can affect the experimental observation of sub-Poissonian statistics.

summaries.en: The paper develops a stochastic model of a continuously driven two-level single-photon source and shows that when excitation and radiative decay rates are comparable, its emitted light can exhibit sub-Poissonian (nonclassical) photon statistics despite continuous excitation, further analyzing how detection inefficiency and detector dead time impact experimental observability.
summaries.zh: 论文建立了一个对连续驱动两能级单光子源进行随机建模的理论框架，表明当泵浦激发率与辐射衰减率相当时，即便在连续激发条件下其光子发射也可能呈现次泊松（非经典）统计，并进一步分析了探测效率有限与探测器死时间如何影响实验中该现象的观测。

title: Entangling Superconducting Qubits via Energy-Selective Local Reservoirs
abstract: Engineered dissipation provides a powerful route to controlling and stabilizing quantum states in open systems. Superconducting circuits are particularly suited to this approach due to their tunable coupling to dissipative environments. Here we realize programmable local reservoirs for superconducting qubits through parametrically driven coupling to readout resonators, creating energy-selective incoherent pump and loss. Using coupled superconducting qubits, we autonomously stabilize entangled single-excitation states with fidelity up to 90.8%. We probe the stabilization dynamics under varying initial conditions and bath parameters, and implement robust classical shadow estimation for accurate and scalable state characterization. Finally, we numerically study a configuration where the engineered pump and loss share a common dissipative mode, leading to reservoir-mediated interference and classically correlated steady states. Our results demonstrate a scalable and hardware-efficient framework for dissipative preparation and control of correlated many-body states in superconducting circuits.

summaries.en: The paper demonstrates programmable energy-selective local reservoirs in superconducting qubits using parametric coupling to readout resonators to autonomously stabilize high-fidelity entangled single-excitation states, characterize stabilization dynamics with classical shadows, and explore reservoir-mediated interference via a shared dissipative mode.
summaries.zh: 该论文通过在超导量子比特中利用对读出谐振器的参数化耦合实现可编程的能量选择性局域耗散库，自动稳定高保真度的纠缠单激发态，并用经典阴影方法刻画稳定动力学，进一步研究在共享耗散模式下由库介导的干涉及其导致的经典相关稳态。

title: Optical detection of the electron spin resonances of G centers in silicon
abstract: Color centers in silicon are emerging as promising platforms for quantum technologies. Among them, the G center has attracted considerable interest owing to its bright telecom O-band single-photon emission and its optically addressable metastable electron-spin triplet state. Here we investigate the spin properties of ensembles of G centers under above-band-gap excitation. We elucidate the spin photo-dynamics giving rise to the optical detected magnetic resonance (ODMR) response of G centers. The optimal pulsed sequence for measuring the ODMR spectrum of the G defects is identified, along with the temperature and optical-power regimes maximizing the spin readout contrast. Through magneto-optical measurements, we detect a level-anticrossing of the G center electron spin states. At last, we demonstrate coherent spin control of the defects, and characterize their spin-coherence properties. Unveiling the spin degree of freedom of the G center opens new avenues for the realization of quantum memories and quantum registers based on silicon color centers.

summaries.en: The paper studies ensembles of silicon G color centers by modeling their spin photo-dynamics to optimize pulsed ODMR detection conditions, identify regimes that maximize optical readout contrast, observe a level anticrossing via magneto-optics, and demonstrate coherent spin control and coherence characterization for quantum-memory and quantum-register applications.
summaries.zh: 论文在以上带隙激发下研究硅中G色心的自旋性质，阐明其自旋光动力学以优化脉冲ODMR测量序列与最大化光学读出对比度的温度和光功率区间，借助磁光测量观察到能级反交叉，并实现对缺陷自旋的相干控制及其相干性表征，从而为基于硅色心的量子存储器和量子寄存器提供新的思路。

title: Analytical emission model for the design of primary effusive sources
abstract: We present an analytical emission model that accurately predicts the properties of effusive sources formed by long collimation tubes. By construction, it captures the full range of molecular flow, from the transparent flux regime, which occurs in highly rarefied gases, to the opaque regime, which arises as the flux increases and interparticle collisions become non-negligible. The model is based on a previously developed secondary-emission-surface approach, improved here to overcome its internal limitations and recover the well-established axial flux intensity. It provides accurate analytical predictions of the angular intensity distribution in the molecular flow regime, offering valuable guidance for the design of efficient primary sources across a broad range of experiments in atomic and molecular physics
subjects: Atomic Physics (physics.atom-ph) ; Applied Physics (physics.app-ph); Atomic and Molecular Clusters (physics.atm-clus); Chemical Physics (physics.chem-ph)

summaries.en: The paper presents an improved analytical emission model for effusive sources formed by long collimation tubes that accurately captures molecular-flow behavior from the transparent rarefied regime to the opaque collision-dominated regime and reliably predicts angular intensity distributions to guide atomic and molecular physics experiments.
summaries.zh: 论文提出了一种改进的长准直管形成的逸出源解析发射模型，能够从高稀薄“透明”分子流（稀少碰撞）到“致密”碰撞主导的区间全面刻画其行为，并能准确预测分子流条件下的角向强度分布，为原子与分子物理实验中高效主源设计提供指导。

title: Axion-Exchange Contribution to the Energy of Lithium-Like Ions
abstract: Axions and axion-like particles are among the most promising candidates for dark matter and for manifestations of new physics beyond the Standard Model. In the present work, the contribution of axion exchange to the energy of lithium-like ions is investigated within the framework of relativistic bound-state quantum electrodynamics. A formalism for the interelectronic interaction mediated by axion exchange is developed in the Furry picture with finite nuclear size taken into account. Energy shifts are calculated for a wide range of nuclear charge numbers \(Z\) and axion masses. The magnitude of the axion-induced contribution is shown to increase with increasing \(Z\) for all states considered. Based on the analysis of lithium-like bismuth, constraints on the axion-electron interaction parameters are obtained in the high-mass region. The results indicate that precision spectroscopy of highly charged ions is a promising tool for searches for new physics associated with the exchange of pseudoscalar bosons.

summaries.en: The paper develops a relativistic bound-state QED framework to compute axion-exchange contributions to the energies of lithium-like ions, finding that the shifts grow with nuclear charge Z and using lithium-like bismuth to constrain axion-electron couplings in the high-mass regime, showing that precision spectroscopy of highly charged ions can probe pseudoscalar-boson new physics.
summaries.zh: 本文在相对论性束缚态量子电动力学框架下建立了考虑有限核尺寸的Furry图形式主义，计算了轴子交换介导的锂样离子能量修正，发现对所有研究态该修正随核电荷数Z增大而增强，并以锂样铋为例在高质量区域给出了轴子-电子相互作用参数的约束，结果表明对高电荷态离子的精密谱学是探索由类赝标量玻色子交换引发的新物理的有前景手段。
